purpose: Retrospective scoped evidence ledger, not independent labels or detection scores

cases.claim: Both source bodies compute first_block, first_offset, extent and blocks using the same local formulas
cases.scope: Pinned source syntax only; no joint reachable-input or effect equivalence proof
cases.open_claim: A shared range planner can preserve each consumer's errors and I/O effects with worthwhile maintenance cost
cases.needed: Freeze planner boundary, input guards and read/write event traces; compare extraction against originals

cases.claim: The source wrapper calls Self::try_new_with_flags_and_private and adapts its callback with Infallible
cases.scope: Pinned source call expression; compiler-resolved callee identity and runtime traces not collected
cases.open_claim: Additional unification beyond the existing wrapper delegation is useful
cases.needed: Specify residual duplicated responsibility before requesting a new abstraction or measuring benefit

cases.claim: The command adapter rejects count greater than 4096 before its callback and accumulates the accepted payload before calling write
cases.scope: Pinned source control flow; exact-pair execution under partial copy and callback faults not yet performed
cases.open_claim: Replacing the complete-command adapter with the scalar streaming adapter preserves callback and error traces
cases.needed: Exact-pair extracted-body harness with explicit iterator/callback models; empty, oversize, short-copy and callback-error controls

cases.claim: Both new definitions coexist in one crate compilation with a fixed stats feature value
cases.scope: Original S and not(S) predicates plus extracted constructor harness; not full project configuration reachability
cases.open_claim: Initialization can profitably share more code across configuration alternatives
cases.needed: Explicit cross-configuration extraction and actual feature closure before integration or benefit claims

cases.claim: The extracted original permission/type setters preserve the opposite field over the enumerated test domain
cases.scope: 65536 starting u16 states with six permissions or eight node types, debug/release; not all parameter combinations or kernel integration
cases.open_claim: A shared bitfield-update abstraction improves these two operations while preserving their different roles
cases.needed: Keep changed/preserved field roles distinct; evaluate local mechanism separately from whole-operation interchangeability

cases.claim: Unguarded next-multiple arithmetic preserves the boot consumer's rejection of invalid alignment for input (17,3)
cases.scope: One explicit invalid-alignment counterexample in the extracted-function harness; not rejection of guarded sharing
cases.open_claim: Guard-preserving shared alignment arithmetic yields a net improvement across all three consumers
cases.needed: Preserve each input/error contract; measure integration and maintenance/performance tradeoffs independently

annotation_protocol.unit: Named proposition plus source members, configuration, input domain and observation boundary; not bare pair
annotation_protocol.discovery_blinding: Hide detector score/rank and proposed refactor when collecting new relevance judgments; keep source/context needed to judge
annotation_protocol.review: Two reviewers independently state dimension, witness/counterexample and uncertainty before reconciliation; LLM review is not a substitute for independent human reference labels
annotation_protocol.disagreement: Archive both original judgments and reasons, then adjudicate or retain unknown; never silently convert abstention to negative
annotation_protocol.sampling: Six known development seeds are retrospective; freeze separate unseen origin/family groups before effectiveness evaluation
annotation_protocol.metrics: Report per-dimension label coverage and disagreement; no accuracy, recall, kappa or benefit score from this ledger
annotation_protocol.stop: Build six source-bound records and validate rejection controls; next exact-pair experiment must have a frozen observation contract
